# IP2312 board fixture

Source: [krishnax12/ip2312-fast-charging-module](https://tscircuit.com/krishnax12/ip2312-fast-charging-module), release `6a7d6ef1-fb73-4f19-923e-7b32a0ad287f` (package version 0.1.8), `dist/index/circuit.json`, file ID `cfa8f022-cc67-4d9d-b452-cd33485ba72b`.

The complete 844-record board fixture contains 26 PCB components, 45 traces and four rounded rectangular plated pads (`pcb_plated_hole_4` through `pcb_plated_hole_7`). Each of these pads specifies a 2.5 × 2.5 mm pad, a 1.1 mm circular drill and a 0.15 mm corner radius.

The tscircuit recreation is by krishnax12, based on [Sagar Saini's IP2312 charger](https://www.instructables.com/Fast-Charging-Module-for-Lithium-Batteries/). The published source package declares GPL-3.0. This fixture retains that license; see COPYING. Other repository files retain their existing licenses.

This is the published board data, not an independently validated hardware design. It includes an existing routing-DRC runtime error. The snapshot tests exercise Gerber export directly and do not certify connectivity or electrical behavior.
